name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent near $98 on 6 Nov, down 7% in a month; Watch as escorted Gulf shipments recover
state: Brent traded near $97.6 on 6 Nov, down 7% in a month and inside the $85–110 Watch band (Yahoo Finance). CBS News reported on 6 Nov that US escorts have brought Gulf shipments back near pre-war levels, although tankers were still struck on 5 Nov (CBS News; gCaptain). This run could not confirm a physical outage above 2 mb/d, so the status steps down from Alert to Watch.
for_you: Fuel and transport costs remain well above last year's levels. Prices could jump again if attacks on Gulf shipping escalate or US strikes on Iran resume.
rubric_hit: Brent $97.6 in the $85–110 Watch band; >2 mb/d outage not confirmed this run

sources.title: CBS News — Iran war updates: Trump touts imminent decision on new strikes

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
